title: Round 3 (v3): oracle-headroom test of angle A on BRIWECS winter wheat
status: FROZEN before any R3-oracle analysis. POST-HOC ORIGIN DECLARED: this test was proposed AFTER seeing R2 (heading-SD component FAIL, EC-share component PASS). R2 verdict (NO_GO) stands and is not revised; this round asks whether R2's FAIL was driven by the indirect heading-SD criterion.

data.phenotypes_weather: BRIWECS Figshare 10.6084/m9.figshare.27910269 curated table + DWD interpolated daily weather (as used in R2)
data.genotypes: Lichthardt et al. 2019 135K Axiom (221 cultivars) as primary; if QC leaves <180 cultivars, use Voss-Fels 2019 15K (191) - choose by rule before modelling, not by results
data.genotype_qc: biallelic, call rate >=0.9, MAF>=0.05, mean imputation; PCA K=30 on all genotyped cultivars (no phenotypes)
data.trait: grain yield (the curated table's yield column), cultivar mean within env
data.env_definition: location x year x treatment (as R2); envs with >=30 genotyped cultivars having yield and heading

splits: forward years by harvest year: train years < t, test year t, for every t with >=3 prior training years and >=3 qualifying test envs (expected t = 2018, 2019); if only one test year qualifies, use it and declare

features.thermal_time: base 0 C, from env median sowing (as R2)
features.excluded_variable: count days Tmax>30C excluded a priori (near-degenerate in R2: nonzero in 2.5% of records)

models.M0plus: SNP main effects + (PC1..30 x EC_env) + (predicted heading z x EC_env); EC_env anchored at env mean PREDICTED heading (SNP ridge trained on training years)
models.M1oracle: M0plus + dEC_ij main + (PC1..30 x dEC_ij), dEC_ij = EC anchored at OBSERVED cultivar-mean heading in that env minus EC_env (train and test)
models.M1plus_predicted: same as M1oracle but anchored at predicted heading (reported, secondary)
models.estimation: ridge; features z-scored on training rows; SEPARATE penalties for the base block and the dEC block (2-D grid, each 10^-2..10^6 step 0.5 log10) chosen on the last training year as validation, then refit on all training years (change vs round 1 declared: round 1 used one shared penalty)

metric: within-env Pearson of cultivar means, equal-weight mean over test envs; paired env bootstrap 2000, seed 20260928

decision.HEADROOM: r(M1oracle) - r(M0plus) >= 0.01 AND CI lower > 0 -> angle A re-opened on BRIWECS; next round would test predicted alignment (A2/A3) under its own prereg
decision.NO_HEADROOM: otherwise -> angle A closed on BRIWECS irrespective of the R2 heading-SD criterion
decision.note: predicted-heading model M1plus_predicted is secondary and cannot by itself re-open A

reporting_rules: results frozen as JSON with sha256
